text:
🔥 #CoRL2026 is officially SOLD OUT! And I’m on my way to Austin! ✈️

What a journey this has been! Together with my amazing fellow Program Chairs, @Majumdar_Ani and @fox_dieter17849, we’ve spent the past year working to make this year’s CoRL something truly special.

📈 A record-breaking 2,094 submissions, with 687 accepted papers showcasing the incredible progress in robot learning!

🌟 An outstanding scientific program, featuring inspiring keynotes from @wolfram_burgard, @RussTedrake, @drfeifei and a special conversation with Fei-Fei Li and @LisaSu!

💡3 Early Career Keynotes to give the spotlight to the next generation of leaders in robot learning @RobobertoMM @negar_mehr @zhaohang0124!

🚀 New initiatives we’re particularly proud of:
- A Late-Breaking Results track to bring the freshest ideas and emerging directions into the conversation, including Agentic Robotics and Real2Sim2Real.
- A strengthened reviewing structure with Senior Area Chairs to help us manage the growing scale of our community while maintaining scientific rigor. 

Behind all of this is an extraordinary team of organizers, reviewers, area chairs, volunteers, and researchers who have worked incredibly hard to make it happen. Thank you all! ❤️

🤝CoRL has grown tremendously, but what makes it special is still the same: a community that brings together bold ideas, rigorous science, and a shared passion for advancing robot learning.

I can’t wait to see everyone in Austin, hear the discussions, discover new ideas, and celebrate our community together!

We’ve put our hearts into this program. I really hope you enjoy it! ❤️

See you at @corl_conf! 🤖
